questions.question: The market price of an article is Rs. 2720. If a shopkeeper sold the article at 15% loss after giving 25% discount, then the cost price (in Rs.) of the article is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The marked price of an article = Rs. 2720

Loss = 15%

Discount = 25%

**Formula used:**

CP = 100/100 – loss% × SP

**Calculation:**

According to the question

SP = 2720 – 25% of 2720

⇒ 2720 – (25/100 × 2720)

⇒ 2720 – 680

⇒ SP = Rs. 2040

Now,

CP = 100/100 – loss% × SP

⇒ (100/100 – 15) × 2040

⇒ (100/85 × 2040)

⇒ 100 × 24

⇒ Rs. 2400

**∴ The cost price of the article is Rs. 2400**

A shopkeeper bought 20 kg of sugar at Rs. 45 per Kg., 25 kg of sugar at Rs. 50 per kg and 35 kg of sugar at Rs. 40 per kg. He spent a sum of Rs. 450 on transportation and other expenses. He mixed all three types of sugar and sold all the stocks at Rs. 52.50 per kg. His profit percent in the entire transaction is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of sugar of quantity 1 = Rs. 45

Quantity = 20 kg

Rate of sugar of quantity 2 = Rs. 50

Quantity = 25 kg

Rate of sugar of quantity 3 = Rs. 40

Quantity = 35 kg

Money spent on transportation and other expenses = Rs. 450

Selling price of mixed sugar = Rs. 52.50

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP – CP

Profit%= (Profit/CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

CP of sugar of quantity 1 = 45 × 20

⇒ 900

CP of sugar of quantity 2 = 50 × 25

⇒ 1250

CP of sugar of quantity 3 = 40 × 35

⇒ 1400

Total quantity of mixes sugar = (20 + 25 + 35)

⇒ 80

Final CP including transportation and other expenses = (900 + 1250 + 1400 + 450)

⇒ 4000

CP of 1 kg of mixed sugar = 4000/80

⇒ 50

SP of 1 kg of mixed sugar = 52.50

Profit = (52.50 – 50)

⇒ 2.50

Profit% = (2.50/50 × 100)

⇒ 5%

**∴ His profit percentage in the entire transaction is 5%**

questions.question: If x⁸ - 433x⁴ + 16 = 0, x > 0, then what is the value of (x+(2)/(x))?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If x8 - 433x4 + 16 = 0

**Calculation:**

Divided by x⁴

⇒ x8 - 433x4 + 16 = 0

⇒ (x8 - 433x4 + 16)/x⁴ = 0

Now, adding 8 on both sides

⇒ x⁴ + 16/x⁴ + 8 = 433 + 8

⇒ (x² + 4/x²)² = (441)

⇒ (x² + 4/x²) = √441

⇒ (x² + 4/x²) = 21

Now, adding 4 on both sides

⇒ (x2 + 4/x2) + 4 = 21 + 4

⇒ (x + 2/x)² = 25

⇒ (x + 2/x) = √25

⇒ (x + 2/x) = 5

**∴ The required value is 5**

chord TS is parallel to diameter PR

questions.question: In a class the ratio of rural to urban students is 4 : 7. In an examination the average percentage marks of the rural and the urban students are respectively 65 and 63. What is the overall percentage marks of the class (correct to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of rural to urban students = 4 : 7

The average percentage marks of rural and urban students = 65 and 63

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The average percentage marks of rural students = 4/11 × 65

⇒ 23.63

The average percentage marks of urban students = 7/11 × 63

⇒ 40.1

The overall percentage marks of the class = (23.63 + 40.1)

⇒ 63.73

**∴ Required overall percentage marks of the class is 63.73% **

questions.question: Find the smallest value of (a - b) so that 42a48b (a > b) is divisible by 11.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The given value = 42a48b

**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule of 11 - The sum of the digits at odd places and the sum of its digits at even places is either 0 or divisible by 11, then the number is divisible by 11.

Calculation:

As per the question

⇒ (4 + a + 8) – (2 + 4 + b) = 0 or multiple of 11

⇒ (12 + a) – (6 + b) = 0 or multiple of 11

⇒ 6 + a – b = 0 or multiple of 11

⇒ (a – b) = 11 – 6

⇒ (a – b) = 5

**∴ The smallest value is 5**

questions.question: There are two water taps in a tank which can fill the empty tank in 12 hours and 18 hours respectively. It is seen that there is a leakage point at the bottom of the tank which can empty the completely filled tank in 36 hours. If both the water taps are opened at the same time to fill the empty tank and leakage point was repaired after 1 hour, then in how much time the empty tank will be completely filled?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by first water tap to fill the empty tank = 12 hours

Time taken by second water tap to fill the empty tank = 18 hours

Time taken by leakage to empty the filled tank = 36 hours

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 12, 18 and 36 is 36

Efficiency of first water tap = 36/12 = 3 units/hr

Efficiency of second water tap = 36/18 = 2 units/hr

Efficiency of leakage = 36/36 = 1 unit/hr

Efficiency of these 2 taps and leakage together = (3 + 2 – 1) = 4 units/hr

Remaining units = (36 – 4) = 32 units

Work done by two tap water together to fill the empty tank = 32/(3 + 2) hr

⇒ 32/5 hr

⇒ 6.4 hours = 6 hours + 0.4 hours (0.4 hours = 24 minutes)

⇒ 6 hr 24 min

Total time taken to fill the empty tank = (6 hr 24 min + 1 hr)

⇒ 7 hr 24 min

**∴ The empty tank will completely filled in 7 hr 24 minutes**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4df4d9f4b23bcfce8341b3f352725adcb1f91d47008330a1e5da30f1e7bb668d.png] 

For the first one hour = (3 + 2 - 1) × 1 = 4 units

Time to fill remaning tank = (36 - 4) ÷ (3 + 2) = 6.4 hours

Total time taken = (6.4 + 1) = 7.4 hours = 7 hr 24 min

∴ The empty tank will completely filled in 7 hr 24 minutes

questions.question: A borrowed a sum of Rs. 160000 from B at 10% per annum simple interest. At the same time he lent the same sum to C at the same rate on compound interest, compounded semi-annually for 2 years, Find the amount (in Rs.) earned by A in the whole transaction.
questions.solution:
** Given:**

Principal = Rs. 160000

Rate = 10%

Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P × (1 + r/100)t

CI = Amount – Principal

When compound semi-annually, r' = r/2 and t' = 2 × t

**Calculation:**

According to the question

SI = (160000 × 10 × 2)/100

⇒ Rs. 32000

Now,

Compounded amount when compounded semi annually = P(1 + r/200)² × t

Compounded amount = 160000[1 + 10/200)² × ²

⇒ 160000(21/20)⁴

⇒ Rs. (160000 × 21/20 × 21/20 × 21/20 × 21/20)

⇒ Rs. 194481

CI = Amount – Principal = (194481 – 160000)

⇒ Rs. 34481

Now, the amount earned by A in the whole transaction = CI – SI

⇒ (34481 – 32000)

⇒ Rs. 2481

**∴ Required amount earned by A in the whole transaction is 2481**

questions.question: A train running at 72 km/h crosses a pole in 12 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take to cross a bridge 360 m long?
questions.solution:

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Speed = 72 × 5/18

⇒ 20 m/s

Distance = Length = (20 × 12) m

⇒ 240 m

Now,

Time = Distance/Speed

⇒ (360 + 240)/20

⇒ 600/20

⇒ 30 sec

**∴ Required time is 30 sec**

questions.question: What is the volume (in cm³) of a spherical shell whose inner and outer radii are respectively 2 cm and 3 cm?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Inner radius (r) = 2 cm

Outer radius (R) = 3 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of a hollow sphere of outer radius R and inner radius r = 4/3π(R³ – r³)

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Volume of a hollow sphere of outer radius R and inner radius r = 4/3π(R3 – r3)

⇒ 4/3 × π × (3³ – 2³)

⇒ 4/3 × π × (27 – 8)

⇒ 4/3 × π × 19

⇒ 76π/3

**∴ Volume of spherical shell is 76π/3**
